summary: Docs site: add redirects/vanity URLs for AWS/GCP Marketplace submission + partner validation
description:
Requester: Elliot Price (Docs)
Requested by: Partnerships + PMM for AWS/GCP marketplace submission forms

Context
- AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace submission forms require stable, publicly reachable URLs for: product overview, onboarding guide, support, and security documentation.
- Current draft URLs have changed due to IA updates and docs PR review feedback; older links in partner portals are returning 404 or redirecting multiple hops.
- We need a small set of vanity URLs + explicit redirects to the final canonical pages, to avoid delays during partner validation.

Impact
- Partner review blocked on validation of URLs (AWS/GCP reviewers click through).
- GTM risk: listing submission iteration delayed if URLs change again.

Request
1) Add/confirm vanity URLs (short paths) that 301 to the canonical pages.
2) Ensure redirects are single-hop (no chaining), and preserve query strings.
3) Confirm behavior for trailing slashes and case sensitivity.
4) Provide final list of URLs to hand to Partnerships for portal entry.

Redirects needed (source -> destination)
- /marketplace -> /docs/marketplace
- /marketplace/aws -> /docs/marketplace/aws/onboarding
- /marketplace/gcp -> /docs/marketplace/gcp/onboarding
- /marketplace/onboarding -> /docs/marketplace/onboarding/overview
- /marketplace/security -> /docs/security/marketplace-overview
- /marketplace/faq -> /docs/marketplace/faq
- /security/marketplace -> /docs/security/marketplace-overview
- /support/marketplace -> /docs/marketplace/support-and-slas

Notes/constraints
- These should be safe to publish publicly (no gated evidence links). Evidence links remain 'on request' per Security publication plan.
- Marketplace portals sometimes cache; prefer not to change these vanity URLs post-submission.

Acceptance criteria
- All source paths return HTTP 301 to the destination.
- No redirect loops; no double-redirects.
- Tested from external network (not just internal preview) and works on both http->https normalization and www/non-www normalization.

Owner(s)
- Primary: Docs/DevEx (Alex Martinez)
- Infra assist: Web/docs site config (as needed)

Requested due date
- 2026-02-09 (before AWS listing resubmission window)

References
- Internal helpdesk request tied to marketplace submission checklists (PM-1845 / PM-1846)
- Docs PRs updating the IA and final paths (pr-3421, pr-3422, pr-3423)
comments: 2026-02-02 10:14 (Elliot Price): Creating INT ticket per Partnerships request. AWS portal flagged 2 URLs as invalid (404). We’re also seeing GCP reviewer notes asking for a single security overview URL. Need vanity paths that won’t change when we iterate IA.

2026-02-03 11:30 (Elliot Price): Destinations should be stable after PR-3421 + PR-3422 merge. PR-3423 only tweaks packaging pages; doesn’t impact these. Please keep query strings because AWS adds tracking params in validation sometimes.
2026-02-04 16:18 (Alex Martinez): Implemented redirect rules in docs site config; testing in preview now. Ensured single-hop and query-string passthrough. Will validate externally once deployed.

2026-02-05 13:41 (Alex Martinez): Deployed to prod. External checks:
- /marketplace -> 301 -> /docs/marketplace
- /marketplace/security -> 301 -> /docs/security/marketplace-overview
All requested sources returning 301; no loops observed. Trailing slash normalization confirmed.
Handing final vanity URL list to Partnerships + PMM.

resolution: Added production docs-site vanity URLs and 301 redirects for AWS/GCP Marketplace submission and partner validation; validated externally with single-hop redirects and query-string passthrough.
security_considerations: Redirect targets are public, marketplace-safe pages only; gated SOC2/ISO evidence links are not exposed via vanity paths.
